verdict.rationale: BigQuery ships AI features (Gemini in BigQuery, conversational analytics, AI functions), so a buyer can fairly ask whether customer data is excluded from AI model training. The evidence pack has no documented training opt-out, data-use policy, or guarantee on this point. Compliance certifications, IAM roles, and customer-owned Iceberg storage are adjacent controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
